name: hasBFPP_iff_extremallyDisconnected
code:
theorem hasBFPP_iff_extremallyDisconnected [T2Space K] :
    HasBFPP C(K, ℝ) ↔ ExtremallyDisconnected K

name: exists_transfinite_realization
code:
theorem exists_transfinite_realization (hF : IsFSpace K) (hED : ¬ ExtremallyDisconnected K) :
    ∃ κ : Ordinal.{u}, κ.card.ord = κ ∧ κ.card.IsRegular ∧ ℵ₀ < κ.card ∧
      ∃ D : Set (BoundedFamily (OrdinalIndex κ)),
        D.Nonempty ∧ IsClosed D ∧ Bornology.IsBounded D ∧ Convex ℝ D ∧
        ∃ (A : UnitBall C(K, ℝ) → D) (J : D → UnitBall C(K, ℝ)) (P : D → D),
          LipschitzWith 1 A ∧ LipschitzWith 1 J ∧ LipschitzWith 1 P ∧ IsTCP D P ∧
          (∀ z, A (J (P z)) ≠ z) ∧
          LipschitzWith 1 (fun f => J (P (A f))) ∧ (∀ f, J (P (A f)) ≠ f)

name: exists_complex_fixedPointFree_of_not_ED
code:
theorem exists_complex_fixedPointFree_of_not_ED [T2Space K] (hK : ¬ ExtremallyDisconnected K) :
    ∃ S : UnitBall C(K, ℂ) → UnitBall C(K, ℂ), LipschitzWith 1 S ∧ ∀ f, S f ≠ f

name: UnitBall
code: abbrev UnitBall (X : Type u) [SeminormedAddCommGroup X] := {x : X // ‖x‖ ≤ 1}

name: HasBFPP
code:
def HasBFPP (X : Type u) [SeminormedAddCommGroup X] : Prop :=
  ∀ T : UnitBall X → UnitBall X, LipschitzWith 1 T → ∃ x, T x = x

name: IsFSpace
BoundedFamily
code:
abbrev BoundedFamily (ι : Type u) :=
  @BoundedContinuousFunction ι ℝ ⊥ inferInstance

name: IsTCP
code:
structure IsTCP (D : Set (BoundedFamily (OrdinalIndex κ))) (P : D → D) : Prop where
  positive : 0 < κ
  nonempty : D.Nonempty
  at_zero : ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x, (P x).val ⟨0, positive⟩ = c
  successor_rules : ∀ i : OrdinalIndex κ, i.val ∈ range (Order.succ : Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}) →
    ∃ Φ : range (inputPrefix D i) → ℝ, LipschitzWith 1 Φ ∧
      ∀ x, Φ (prefixLift D i x) = (P x).val i
  limit_rules : ∀ i : OrdinalIndex κ, IsSuccLimit i.val →
    ∃ ε : Bool, ∀ x, (P x).val i =
      if ε then upperEnvelope (inputPrefix D i x) else lowerEnvelope (inputPrefix D i x)
